name: Dominican Republic

authority.name: INDOTEL — Instituto Dominicano de las Telecomunicaciones
authority.operator: 8 accredited TSPs: NOVOSIT, digifirma (Cámara de Comercio y Producción de Santo Domingo), OGTIC, AVANSI/Viafirma, Thomas Signe, Lleidanet Dominicana, ABA, Digito

technology.trustList: ETSI TS 119 612 — LISTA ELECTRONICA DE CONFIANZA REP. DOMINICANA

notes: Federated accredited-TSL model like Peru: INDOTEL accredits independent TSPs, each with its own root, published via an ETSI TS 119 612 Trusted List (XAdES-signed, SchemeTerritory DO). The DR list is non-standard — it emits bare-word service statuses ("Granted"/"Withdrawn") instead of the ETSI status URIs (handled in extract-tsl.mjs). Some anchors are Spanish roots (Signe, Lleidanet, Evicertia) backing DO-accredited services. Phase 1 stages the granted-status anchors; 2 withdrawn services excluded. Nothing is promoted to current/ until each fingerprint is cross-checked against the XAdES-signed list.
